'''Andrea Bargnani''' (born [[October 26]], [[1985]] in [[Rome]]) is an [[Italy|Italian]] professional [[basketball]] player, currently playing for [[Pallacanestro Treviso|Benetton Treviso]] in the Italian league, who has declared for the [[2006 NBA Draft]]. Scouts have rated him as a top-5 selection, praising him for tremendous quickness for a seven footer, and solid jump shooting. He has drawn many comparisons to German seven footer and perimeter shooter [[Dirk Nowitzki]] of the [[Dallas Mavericks]].
He is a [[power forward]] of 211 cm (6'11") and 105 kg.

Bargnani is considered a top draft pick for the NBA 2006 draft.
